caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted container with a scalloped, arched backplate and a rectangular open box at the bottom, oriented forward. The backplate has a textured, dark gray surface with a prominent central floral decoration consisting of yellow-brown, red, and dark red petal shapes radiating out from a small white circular center. The edges of the arched backplate are accentuated with radiating darker lines. The box portion at the base has angled sides and a frontal section decorated with a horizontal floral border containing red and green leafy motifs against a muted beige background. The drawing is rendered on a plain off-white background with no additional objects present.
title: Match Holder
